role.zh: 360 算法高级研究员 · 基础大模型团队负责人

intro.zh: 孙林，360 智脑事业部算法高级研究员、基础大模型团队负责人，兼任 360 集团技术委员会算法分委会主席、北大–360 大模型联合实验室学术委员会委员。研究与工程工作聚焦基础大模型与后训练、大模型安全与可信生成、RAG 与文档智能，以及记忆、经验与 Agent 系统。
intro.en: Lin Sun is a senior algorithm researcher and foundation-model team lead in 360’s Zhibrain Division, chair of the Algorithm Subcommittee of the 360 Technology Committee, and a member of the Academic Committee of the PKU–360 Joint Laboratory for Large Models. His research and engineering work focuses on foundation models and post-training, LLM safety and trustworthy generation, RAG and document intelligence, and memory, experience, and agent systems.

educationDetails.zh: 哈尔滨工业大学 · 计算机科学与技术本科；计算机科学与技术（智能技术与自然语言处理方向）硕士。
educationDetails.en: Harbin Institute of Technology · BEng in Computer Science and Technology; MSc in Computer Science and Technology, intelligent technology and natural language processing.

background.zh: 毕业于哈尔滨工业大学，获计算机科学与技术学士、硕士学位。2010 年起从事 AI 研发与管理，先后任职于腾讯、360、贝壳找房与如视，经历推荐系统、搜索问答、语言智能、数据智能与 AI 应用等方向。在贝壳 / 如视历任高级经理、总监、高级总监、中心总经理，曾带领百人规模跨职能团队，推进小贝助手、AI 讲房等产品研发与交付。
background.en: He holds bachelor’s and master’s degrees in Computer Science and Technology from Harbin Institute of Technology. Since 2010, he has worked at Tencent, 360, Beike, and Rushi across recommendation, search and question answering, language intelligence, data intelligence, and AI applications. At Beike and Rushi, he served as senior manager, director, senior director, and center general manager, leading a cross-functional team of around one hundred people and delivering products including Xiaobei Assistant and AI House Tour.

field.zh: 计算机科学与技术 · 智能技术与自然语言处理
field.en: Computer Science and Technology · Intelligent Technology and Natural Language Processing

title.zh: 贝壳 / 如视 · 跨职能团队管理

text.zh: 曾带领百人规模跨职能团队，覆盖 NLP、搜索、知识图谱、语音、数据智能，以及工程、产品与测试。负责技术路线、团队建设与产品交付，代表工作包括小贝助手和 AI 讲房。小贝助手被写入贝壳美股上市招股说明书；AI 训练场获得北京电视台专题报道。
text.en: Led a cross-functional team of around one hundred people across NLP, search, knowledge graphs, speech, data intelligence, engineering, product, and testing. Responsibilities included technical direction, team building, and product delivery, with work including Xiaobei Assistant and AI House Tour. Xiaobei Assistant was included in Beike’s U.S. IPO prospectus; the AI training platform was featured in a Beijing Television special report.

title.zh: 360 · 研究与工程协同

text.zh: 负责基础大模型团队的技术路线与研发组织，围绕模型训练、后训练、安全治理、RAG 和记忆系统协调研究与工程工作，推进评测、系统设计与交付。
text.en: Leads technical direction and R&D for the foundation-model team, coordinating research and engineering across model training, post-training, safety, RAG, and memory systems, including evaluation, system design, and delivery.

honors.zh: 《大模型安全关键技术及应用》项目获 2025 年北京市科学技术进步二等奖，孙林作为第二完成人参与该项目；入选北京市朝阳区凤凰人才，获“首都网络安全人才”称号。担任大数据协同安全技术国家工程研究中心大模型专委会主任，并为 ACL、EMNLP、AAAI 等会议审稿人。
honors.en: The project “Key Technologies and Applications of Large-Model Safety” received the 2025 Beijing Science and Technology Progress Award, Second Prize; Lin Sun participated as the second project contributor. He was selected for the Chaoyang Phoenix Talent program and named a Capital Cybersecurity Talent. He directs the Large-Model Committee at the National Engineering Research Center for Collaborative Security of Big Data and reviews for conferences including ACL, EMNLP, and AAAI.

researchOutput.zh: 以第一作者或通讯作者发表的代表论文包括 InduOCRBench（ACL）、BEAR（EMNLP）、TriPlay-RL（ACL）和 Magic Token（AAAI），并以第一作者发布 TinyR1 技术报告与开源模型。发明专利涉及大模型安全、知识库与语料构建、搜索问答和智能交互；参与大模型评测、知识图谱技术框架、虚拟现实从业人员能力要求等国家及行业标准工作，以及《大模型安全研究报告（2024 年）》编写。
researchOutput.en: His first-author or corresponding-author publications include InduOCRBench (ACL), BEAR (EMNLP), TriPlay-RL (ACL), and Magic Token (AAAI); he is also first author of the TinyR1 technical report and released its open model. His invention patents cover LLM safety, knowledge bases and corpora, search and question answering, and intelligent interaction. He contributes to national and industry standards on large-model evaluation, knowledge-graph frameworks, and competency requirements for VR professionals, as well as the Report on Large Language Model Safety (2024).

zh: 孙林，360智脑事业部算法高级研究员、基础大模型团队负责人，兼任360集团技术委员会算法分委会主席、北大–360大模型联合实验室学术委员会委员、大数据协同安全技术国家工程研究中心大模型专委会主任。研究聚焦大模型后训练、安全与可信生成、RAG与文档智能，以及智能体的记忆与经验机制。
毕业于哈尔滨工业大学，2010年起从事AI研发，先后任职于腾讯、360、贝壳找房与如视。曾任贝壳中心总经理，带领百人规模跨职能团队，推动小贝助手、AI讲房等产品落地。《大模型安全关键技术及应用》项目获2025年北京市科学技术进步二等奖，孙林作为第二完成人参与该项目；入选朝阳区凤凰人才，获“首都网络安全人才”称号。
以第一作者或通讯作者在NeurIPS、ACL、EMNLP、AAAI等国际会议发表多篇论文，并担任审稿人。负责开源推理模型TinyR1的训练与发布。获多项发明专利授权，参与制定国家及行业标准3项。
en: Lin Sun is a senior algorithm researcher and foundation-model team lead in 360’s Zhibrain Division. He also chairs the Algorithm Subcommittee of the 360 Technology Committee, serves on the Academic Committee of the PKU–360 Joint Laboratory for Large Models, and directs the Large-Model Committee at the National Engineering Research Center for Collaborative Security of Big Data. His research focuses on LLM post-training, safety and trustworthy generation, RAG and document intelligence, and memory and experience mechanisms for agents.

A graduate of Harbin Institute of Technology, he has worked in AI R&D since 2010 at Tencent, 360, Beike, and Rushi. As a center general manager at Beike, he led a cross-functional team of around one hundred people and delivered products including Xiaobei Assistant and AI House Tour. The project “Key Technologies and Applications of Large-Model Safety” received the 2025 Beijing Science and Technology Progress Award, Second Prize; Lin Sun participated as the second project contributor. He was selected for the Chaoyang Phoenix Talent program and named a Capital Cybersecurity Talent.

He has published multiple first-author or corresponding-author papers at international conferences including NeurIPS, ACL, EMNLP, and AAAI, and serves as a conference reviewer. He led the training and release of the open reasoning model TinyR1, holds multiple granted invention patents, and contributed to three national and industry standards.

zh: 从搜索问答与推荐系统，到语言智能、数据智能，再到大模型与智能体，研究与工程实践始终围绕模型能力如何解决真实场景中的问题展开。2010年起，先后在腾讯、360、贝壳找房与如视从事研发与管理，工作涵盖算法研究、系统研发、技术路线制定、跨职能团队建设与产品交付。
目前担任360智脑事业部算法高级研究员、基础大模型团队负责人，重点推进大模型后训练、安全与可信生成、RAG与文档智能，以及智能体记忆与经验机制的研究和工程实践。
en: His work has evolved from search, question answering, and recommendation systems to language intelligence, data intelligence, large models, and agents, with a focus on applying model capabilities to real-world problems. Since 2010, he has worked in R&D and management at Tencent, 360, Beike, and Rushi, spanning algorithm research, systems engineering, technical direction, cross-functional team building, and product delivery.

He is currently a senior algorithm researcher and foundation-model team lead in 360’s Zhibrain Division, working on LLM post-training, safety and trustworthy generation, RAG and document intelligence, and memory and experience mechanisms for agents.

title.zh: 论文与开源

text.zh: 以第一作者或通讯作者在NeurIPS、ACL、EMNLP、AAAI等国际会议发表论文。代表工作包括面向文档RAG的InduOCRBench与BEAR、大模型安全对齐TriPlay-RL与Magic Token，以及模型融合、长上下文训练和智能体经验迁移研究。负责开源推理模型TinyR1的训练与发布。
text.en: His first-author or corresponding-author publications appear at NeurIPS, ACL, EMNLP, and AAAI. Representative work includes InduOCRBench and BEAR for document RAG, TriPlay-RL and Magic Token for LLM safety alignment, and research on model merging, long-context training, and agent experience transfer. He led the training and release of the open reasoning model TinyR1.

title.zh: 专利与标准

text.zh: 获多项发明专利授权，涉及大模型安全与模型优化、知识库与语料构建、搜索问答和智能交互。参与制定《人工智能 大模型 第2部分：评测指标与方法》《人工智能 知识图谱技术框架》《虚拟现实从业人员能力要求》3项国家及行业标准，并参与《大模型安全研究报告（2024年）》编写。
text.en: He holds granted invention patents in LLM safety and model optimization, knowledge bases and corpora, search and question answering, and intelligent interaction. He contributed to three national and industry standards covering large-model evaluation, knowledge-graph frameworks, and competency requirements for VR professionals, as well as the Report on Large Language Model Safety (2024).

text.zh: 研究长上下文数据选择、推理路径监督和模型融合，提升模型的推理效率与泛化能力。
text.en: Research on long-context data selection, reasoning-path supervision, and model merging to improve reasoning efficiency and generalization.

text.en: Research on dynamic attacks, safety alignment, and hierarchical policy control, balancing risk protection, task utility, and generation reliability.

title.zh: RAG、记忆与 Agent

text.en: Research on evidence loss in complex documents, multi-document evidence allocation, long-term memory, and experience transfer in realistic agent workflows.

text.zh: 负责基础模型、后训练、安全与可信生成、RAG、记忆和经验系统等方向的技术研发与团队协作。
text.en: Research and team leadership across foundation models, post-training, safety, trustworthy generation, RAG, memory, and experience systems.

title.zh: TinyR1：推理、安全与模型融合

summary.zh: 围绕 32B 开源模型开展分支蒸馏、安全控制和分布感知模型融合，兼顾推理、指令遵循与安全表现。
summary.en: Open 32B models spanning branch-merge distillation, safety control, and distribution-aware model merging for reasoning, instruction following, and safety.

problem.zh: 如何在较小模型规模下保留高质量的推理能力，并让方法可供研究者复用？
problem.en: How can compact models retain strong reasoning ability while making the method accessible to other researchers?

approach.zh: Preview 通过数学、编程、科学分支蒸馏与模型融合迁移能力；TinyR1-32B 引入 Control Token 联合优化推理与安全；SCF-RKL 通过稀疏互补更新与逆 KL 约束控制融合干扰。
approach.en: Preview transfers capabilities through math, coding, and science branches followed by merging. TinyR1-32B uses Control Tokens for reasoning and safety; SCF-RKL controls merging interference through sparse complementary updates and reverse KL.

result.zh: TinyR1 获国家自然科学基金委员会报道，曾进入 Hugging Face Trending Top 5。Preview 的 32B 参数约为 DeepSeek-R1 671B 的 5%，AIME 2024 得分为 78.1，对照 DeepSeek-R1 的 79.8。
result.en: TinyR1 received coverage from the National Natural Science Foundation of China and reached the Hugging Face Trending Top 5. Preview uses 32B parameters, about 5% of DeepSeek-R1’s 671B, with an AIME 2024 score of 78.1 versus 79.8.

evidence.zh: 公开入口：论文、Hugging Face 模型页、北京大学计算机学院团队新闻。
evidence.en: Public evidence: the paper, Hugging Face model page, and the Peking University Computer Science news item.

boundary.zh: TinyR1-32B-Preview、后续安全模型和不同媒体报道分开记录。
boundary.en: TinyR1-32B-Preview, later safety models, and separate media reports are kept as distinct records.

title.zh: TinyR1-32B-Preview · Branch-Merge 蒸馏

text.zh: 相对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B，数学、编程、科学得分分别提升 5.5、4.4、2.9 个点。表中为论文 Table 1 的 pass@1；LiveCodeBench 使用 24.08–25.02 子集。
text.en: Compared with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, scores improve by 5.5 points in math, 4.4 in coding, and 2.9 in science. Table 1 reports pass@1; LiveCodeBench uses the 24.08–25.02 subset.

alt.zh: Branch-Merge 蒸馏流程与数学、编程、科学评测结果
alt.en: Branch-Merge Distillation and math, coding, and science results

title.zh: TinyR1-32B · 推理、指令遵循与安全

text.zh: 模型卡采用 20K 高质量样本与三轮 SFT，通过 Control Token 切换任务模式。以下为 TinyR1-32B 模型卡评测；Constructive Safety 为 HarmBench、JBB-Behaviors、S-Eval_attack、wildjailbreak 的平均分。
text.en: The model card describes three SFT rounds on 20K high-quality samples with Control Tokens for task modes. Results below are from the TinyR1-32B card. Constructive Safety averages HarmBench, JBB-Behaviors, S-Eval_attack, and wildjailbreak.

title.zh: SCF-RKL · 分布感知模型融合

text.zh: 在 TinyR1-Preview-Math-32B 与 TinyR1-Preview-Science-32B 的融合实验中，SCF-RKL 的十项基准平均分为 65.33。表列论文 Table 1 的部分单项分数与原表十项平均分；图示为 Figure 9 中推理模型与安全模型的另一组融合实验。
text.en: SCF-RKL achieves a ten-benchmark average of 65.33 when merging TinyR1-Preview-Math-32B and TinyR1-Preview-Science-32B. Selected individual scores and the original ten-task average are from Table 1. Figure 9 shows a separate experiment merging reasoning- and safety-specialized models.

alt.en: SCF-RKL: reasoning, safety, and merged models across benchmarks

title.zh: 大模型安全与可信生成

summary.zh: 动态攻防、闭环训练与检测—代答分离的研究和工程实践；相关项目获北京市科学技术进步二等奖。
summary.en: Research and engineering across dynamic attack–defense, closed-loop training, and detection–response separation; the related project received the Beijing Science and Technology Progress Award, Second Prize.

problem.zh: 面对持续变化的越狱攻击、风险内容和幻觉问题，如何兼顾防护效果与正常任务体验？
problem.en: How can protection against evolving jailbreaks, harmful content, and hallucinations preserve useful task performance?

role.zh: 项目第二完成人、创新点 1 和 2 技术负责人；负责总体方案、关键算法、模型训练、系统设计与落地推进。
role.en: Second project member and technical lead for innovations 1 and 2; responsible for the overall design, key algorithms, model training, system design, and delivery.

approach.zh: 攻击生成 → 自动评测 → 安全训练 → 在线防护 → 经验回流。相关研究包括 TriPlay-RL 与 Magic-Token 安全控制。
approach.en: Attack generation → evaluation → safety training → online protection → experience feedback. Related work includes TriPlay-RL and Magic-Token safety control.

label.zh: 可信 AI 媒体采访

result.zh: 形成 TriPlay-RL、Magic Token、检测—代答分离和可信生成等技术成果；相关项目获北京市科学技术进步二等奖。成果《大模型安全关键技术及应用》于 2025 年 6 月 19 日通过 CAAI 科技成果鉴定。
result.en: The work includes TriPlay-RL, Magic Token, detection–response separation, and trustworthy generation. The related project received the Beijing Science and Technology Progress Award, Second Prize. “Key Technologies and Applications of Large-Model Safety” passed a CAAI technology achievement appraisal on June 19, 2025.

evidence.zh: 论文：TriPlay-RL、Magic Token、Beyond Static Alignment；公开材料：北京市科学技术进步二等奖、CAAI 鉴定证书（2025-06-19）。
evidence.en: Papers: TriPlay-RL, Magic Token, and Beyond Static Alignment. Public evidence: the Beijing Science and Technology Progress Award and CAAI appraisal certificate dated 2025-06-19.

boundary.zh: 只展示公开项目、论文和鉴定材料中的结果，不展示内部线上业务指标。

title.zh: RAG 与可信知识服务

summary.zh: 从工业文档 OCR 鲁棒性到多文档证据分配，构建文档理解、检索与可信生成的评测和技术体系。
summary.en: Document understanding, retrieval, and trustworthy generation, from industrial OCR robustness to budgeted multi-document evidence allocation.

problem.zh: 检索与 OCR 结果并不总能形成可靠答案。如何利用多份文档中的有效证据，并理解文档噪声的影响？
problem.en: Retrieval and OCR quality alone do not guarantee reliable answers. How can systems allocate evidence across documents and account for document noise?

role.zh: 负责研究问题、评测体系、实验组织、结果分析、InduOCRBench 论文撰写，以及 RAG 技术路线、系统方案与落地推进。
role.en: Owned the research question, evaluation system, experiment organization, result analysis, and InduOCRBench paper writing, alongside the RAG technical direction, system design, and delivery.

approach.zh: 结合知识检索、文档结构、证据分配与生成评测。相关论文覆盖 OCR-RAG 鲁棒性、BEAR 多文档证据分配和 TextlessRAG 视觉文档问答。
approach.en: Combining retrieval, document structure, evidence allocation, and generation evaluation. Related papers cover OCR robustness for RAG, budgeted multi-document evidence allocation, and visual-document RAG.

result.zh: InduOCRBench 覆盖 12 个行业、570 份文档、3,402 页和 11 类挑战；BEAR 在统一生成器与证据预算下评估层次化检索和多文档推理。
result.en: InduOCRBench spans 12 industries, 570 documents, 3,402 pages, and 11 challenge types. BEAR evaluates hierarchical retrieval and multi-document reasoning under a shared generator and evidence budget.

evidence.zh: 论文：When Good OCR Is Not Enough、BEAR、TextlessRAG、VIP-Doc、Expand VSR；公开团队文章：360 智脑 RAG 方案。
evidence.en: Papers: When Good OCR Is Not Enough, BEAR, TextlessRAG, VIP-Doc, and Expand VSR. Public team evidence: the 360 Zhibrain RAG article.

boundary.zh: 这些数字是论文或研究基准结果；不展示业务调用量和内部线上效果。
boundary.en: These are paper or benchmark results; business traffic and internal production outcomes are excluded.

title.zh: InduOCRBench · 工业文档鲁棒性

text.zh: 视觉样式文档的 OCR 准确率为 82.9%，对应 RAG 准确率为 52.8%，相差 30.1 个百分点。以下为论文 Table 2 中十种方法在通用与工业文档基准上的综合指标（Avg）。
text.en: Visual-style documents reach 82.9% OCR accuracy but 52.8% RAG answer accuracy, a 30.1-point gap. Table 2 compares the Avg scores of ten methods on general and industrial-document benchmarks.

sourceLabel.zh: When Good OCR Is Not Enough · Table 2 / Figure 2
sourceLabel.en: When Good OCR Is Not Enough · Table 2 / Figure 2

alt.zh: InduOCRBench：OCR 错误到检索与生成失效的端到端评测流程
alt.en: InduOCRBench: end-to-end evaluation of OCR errors, retrieval, and generation

sourceLabel.zh: When Good OCR Is Not Enough · Figure 2
sourceLabel.en: When Good OCR Is Not Enough · Figure 2

title.zh: BEAR · 有限预算下的证据分配

text.zh: DragonBall 检索对比采用 Qwen3-32B 生成器，证据上下文在适用时按约 4K token 预算对齐；LongRefiner 使用不同的辅助模型。表列三次实验的均值 ± 标准差。BEAR(docs) 在 2Wiki 上的 EM/F1 为 34.63 ± 2.17 / 48.02 ± 1.45。
text.en: DragonBall retrieval comparisons use a Qwen3-32B generator, with evidence contexts aligned to approximately 4K tokens where applicable; LongRefiner uses a different auxiliary model. Values are mean ± standard deviation over three runs. BEAR(docs) achieves 34.63 ± 2.17 EM and 48.02 ± 1.45 F1 on 2Wiki.

alt.zh: BEAR：离线层次索引与在线粗到细的探索—恢复双路径
alt.en: BEAR: offline hierarchical indexing and online coarse-to-fine exploration and recovery

title.zh: 记忆、经验与 Agent 系统

summary.zh: 推进 Mem360 长期记忆与经验复用，围绕 Agent 工作流、记忆安全和经验服务开展研究。
summary.en: Advances Mem360 long-term memory and experience reuse, with research on agent workflows, memory safety, and experience serving.

problem.zh: 如何跨对话保持状态、从任务反馈中复用经验，并理解 Agent 的效果与运行环境之间的关系？
problem.en: How can agents preserve state, reuse experience from feedback, and account for the effect of runtime environments on performance?

role.zh: 推进长期记忆与经验复用方向的技术工作，参与相关研究。
role.en: Technical work on long-term memory and experience reuse.

approach.zh: Mem360 面向长期用户状态与个性化；经验服务面向任务复盘与反馈复用。关联研究包括 Harness-Bench、MemAudit、ArborMem 与经验服务。
approach.en: Mem360 concerns long-term user state and personalization; experience serving concerns task reflection and reusable feedback. Related research includes Harness-Bench, MemAudit, ArborMem, and experience serving.

result.zh: Mem360 公开技术文章报告 LoCoMo Overall 76.46、Temporal reasoning 83.32 等结果；相关研究覆盖 Agent 工作流评测、记忆安全和经验服务。
result.en: The public Mem360 technical article reports LoCoMo Overall 76.46 and Temporal reasoning 83.32, among other results. Related research covers agent-workflow evaluation, memory safety, and experience serving.

evidence.zh: 公开材料：Mem360 技术文章；论文：Harness-Bench、MemAudit、ArborMem、External Experience Serving、When Do Prompt-Side Agent Playbooks Transfer。
evidence.en: Public evidence: the Mem360 technical article. Papers: Harness-Bench, MemAudit, ArborMem, External Experience Serving, and When Do Prompt-Side Agent Playbooks Transfer.
